claim_population: single-process Taskmesh public API on a declared host, feature set, topology and finite work body

claims.primary_metric: nanoseconds per completed operation; allocation and instruction counts reported separately
claims.denominator: asserted completed operations in the named fixture
denial_conditions: operation did not reach the declared state
source, toolchain or fixture identity differs from the baseline
timed setup differs between compared variants

claims.scope: default-feature run_io, run_blocking and run_cpu only until each other public path has its own receipt
claims.denominator: all intended arrivals in each class/path injection cohort
denial_conditions: no predeclared application SLO or minimum completion fraction
generator saturation, observer distortion or missing measured calibration
unsettled queue, worker custody or failed exact correctness oracle
thin tail population or incompatible repeated runs

claims.scope: only the predeclared semantic intersection with each named maintained peer
claims.primary_metric: per-class/path SLO-goodput and resource efficiency across one common absolute rate grid
claims.denominator: all intended arrivals at each common rate point
denial_conditions: no semantically equivalent peer or representative H7 profile
rate grid, SLO or exclusions chosen after measured candidates
missing counterexamples, run-level uncertainty or independent rerun

rate_grid.selection_rule: pilot every candidate on the same host, then freeze one absolute grid spanning all observed knees before measured comparisons

exclusions: source or binary changed during run
scenario, feature, topology or host fingerprint mismatch
missing, duplicate or impossible raw event
failed correctness oracle or residual custody

mechanism_controls: raw Tokio on the same runtime and work body
capacity-only semaphore on the same runtime and work body
Tower concurrency limit/load shed on the same runtime and work body
comparators.inclusion_rule: same public work body, admission and bounded queue, cancellation/deadline, caller terminal, worker custody and drain contract; otherwise restrict claim to the documented intersection

semantic_equivalence.raw_tokio: mechanism control only: no Taskmesh class, bounded admission, typed rejection or worker-custody contract
semantic_equivalence.semaphore: capacity-only control: queue, class policy, deadline and lifecycle semantics require separate matching proof
semantic_equivalence.tower: middleware control: contract intersection must be established before any peer claim
